name: Love at Any Cost
source:
You’ve always put your work before your love life, so when your younger sister announces her engagement, you need to find a date ASAP! Luckily, you find a service that provides just what you’re looking for—a handsome, wealthy businessman. But when you discover that your rental boyfriend is hiding something, will you be able to keep up the charade? Can a fake relationship lead to real love?

Rent your ideal man in Love at Any Cost!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.rentalboyfriend]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你总是把工作放在感情生活之前，所以当你的妹妹宣布订婚时，你需要尽快找到一个约会对象！幸运的是，你找到了一项可以满足你需求的服务——一位英俊、富有的商人。但当你发现你的出租男友隐瞒了一些事情时，你能继续玩这个谜语吗？虚假的关系能带来真爱吗？

不惜一切代价租你理想的爱情男人！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.rentalboyfriend]Google Play[/url]]
